d: What do Lewis Hamilton, Conor McGregor, Max Verstappen and Tyreek Hill have in common? Their excitement over GTA VI. From Formula One drivers waiting to play Grand Theft Auto VI to McGregor giving his employees time off for the game's arrival, the crossover between gaming and professional sport is hard to miss. Rupha Ramani dives deep into why GTA VI has become the latest obsession among sporting superstars.
